g.text: Low training error also occurs with shifted training labels
Video features · seed 0 · 200 steps (ridge is closed-form). Shifted training error uses shifted targets; held-out targets stay correct.
Dotted line: constant-distance held-out baseline. Pair counts and reverse folds are not independent replicates.
